name: Security Compliance
summary:
*   Role: Product Manager at HotWax Commerce.
*   Audience: A retailer (enthusiastic, cares about improvements/features).
*   Task: Summarize a cluster of updates into a cohesive release note entry.
*   Input: A single PR describing the removal of a full service-context log dump in `create#SalesOrder` to prevent PII leakage.

    *   *Problem*: The `create#SalesOrder` service was logging the entire service context (including customer names, addresses, emails, etc.) at an info level. This leaks PII (Personally Identifiable Information) into server logs.
    *   *Solution*: Removed the specific log statement that dumped the full context.
    *   *Impact*: Improved data privacy and reduced log volume/noise.
    *   *Type*: This is a standalone bug fix (it was a "leftover debug log" causing a data leak).

    *   *Structure (Feature/Enhancement)*: Problem, Solution, Impact.
    *   *Structure (Bug Fix)*: "Fixed a bug if [Condition], [Symptom]."
    *   *Style*: Simple, active voice, granular but concise, professional/utility tone.
    *   *Forbidden Words (AI Slop)*: "enhanced", "streamlined", "seamless", "robust".
    *   *Punctuation*: No exclamation points.
